title: Analyzing Overfitting Under Class Imbalance in Neural Networks for Image Segmentation
mechanism: With small data, test-time logits of rare classes shift toward the decision boundary while the majority class does not; asymmetric margin / focal losses applied only to the rare class counter the shift.
adaptation: Asymmetric large margin on the true-class logit of crack, inactive, gridline, splice, edge_dark, material only. First verify the logit shift on our checkpoints (train vs val vs E1 crack-logit histograms); E1 shows 70% of crack pixels at p<0.001, consistent with the claim.
min_experiment: Arm: margin m in {0.5, 1.0}, 3 seeds each on house config; baselines SUP100 and PF; metric test crack recall and mIoU_rob, E1 crack recall secondary; kill if test crack recall gain < 0.02 and E1 recall gain < 0.03.
evidence: R (full text): KiTS kidney tumor, 100% data, post-processed: DSC 79.2 -> 82.3, sensitivity 77.0 -> 81.4 with asymmetric large margin; consistent sensitivity gains on BRATS, ATLAS, KiTS at 10-100% data.
prior_overlap: none: offset-tolerant CE and Dice variants tested, margin / asymmetric focal never tested.

alt_notes.adaptation: Our symptoms match: inactive recall 0.61, and on E1 70% of crack pixels get p<0.001. Apply stronger photometric augmentation only to crack and inactive cells or pixels: contrast, gamma, noise, and a simulated downscale-and-pad for the BMRK style. Add an asymmetric margin on classes 11 and 14. This acts at training time, unlike the inference logit bias already in use.
alt_notes.min_experiment: PF+asymmetric rare-class augmentation vs PF, 5 seeds plus CV. Metrics: CV inactive IoU, BMRK inactive IoU, E1 crack recall@2. Kill if CV inactive gain < +0.015 and E1 recall@2 gain < +0.02.

alt_notes.adaptation: Strong photometric augmentation (contrast, gamma, noise, simulated downscale for BMRK) only inside dilated crack and inactive masks; asymmetric margin on classes 11 and 14. Training-time, unlike the inference logit bias already used.
alt_notes.min_experiment: PF+ASYM vs PF; CV inactive IoU, BMRK inactive IoU, E1 crack recall@2. Kill: CV inactive < +0.015 and E1 recall@2 < +0.02.
